=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2163-2179 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The restore block unconditionally logs success after `sed -i || true` without verifying that `model_reasoning_effort` was actually restored.
  WHY: If the restore edit silently fails, later validate phases run at the discover-level reasoning instead of the intended `medium`, and the log falsely reports success; one reviewer called this high but the highest supported severity across reviewers is medium.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2065-2075 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `sed -i` without an extension is GNU-specific and can fail on BSD/macOS.
  WHY: On affected systems the config rewrite can be skipped, but this was also explicitly identified as a repo-wide pre-existing pattern by other reviewers, so it is not duplicated with the restore-verification issue.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:30-64 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The default reasoning effort changed from `none` to `medium`.
  WHY: This is a backward-incompatible behavior change for standalone callers even though reviewers noted it is intentional and aligned with the catalog/workflow behavior; severity reflects that disagreement.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:116-122 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The comment wording misdescribes how the editor step repatches `~/.codex/config.toml`.
  WHY: The reviewer explicitly characterized this as a documentation/comment inaccuracy, not a runtime bug.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2168-2174 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The restore block uses `sed -i ... || true` followed by an unconditional `echo "Restored ~/.codex/config.toml: model_reasoning_effort=${MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT} after discover phase."` without verifying that the expected line was written.
  WHY: If restore fails silently, later validate phases run with the discover override value instead of the intended `medium`, and the log misleadingly reports success.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2168-2176 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The restore section unconditionally logs success without verifying the sed operation actually modified the config file.
  WHY: If sed fails, the config remains at the discover reasoning level while the log falsely claims it was restored, so subsequent validate phases run at the wrong reasoning level.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2163-2179 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The restore block lacks verification that `sed` succeeded.
  WHY: If restore sed fails, the config stays at the discover level while later validate phases should run at `medium`, and the log misleadingly claims success.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2065-2075 and 2163-2179 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `sed -i` without an extension argument is GNU-specific and fails on BSD/macOS systems.
  WHY: On BSD/macOS standalone/local runs, the config rewrite can be skipped; the reviewer noted this is a known repo-wide pattern but still reported it here.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2169-2174 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Restore sed lacks verification — the unconditional "Restored ..." echo is emitted whenever `_discover_reasoning_patched=true`, but there is no post-sed grep to confirm `model_reasoning_effort = "medium"`.
  WHY: If the restore sed fails, subsequent generate/diagnose/fix-harness phases run at the discover-level reasoning instead of the intended `medium`, and the log misleadingly prints success.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2075-2090 and 2169-2174 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `sed -i` without an extension argument is GNU-specific and fails on BSD/macOS.
  WHY: On BSD/macOS, standalone/local runs will not patch or restore the config, and the reviewer notes this is part of a broader repo-wide pattern.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:42-47 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The default changed from `none` to `medium`.
  WHY: This is a backward-incompatible default change for standalone users, though the reviewer also called it intentional and informational rather than a functional bug.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:116-122 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The new comment states the editor step "re-patches" from a reviewer pass-time level, but the workflow actually writes the editor config fresh earlier and then overrides it.
  WHY: The reviewer explicitly said the code behavior is correct and this is only a documentation/comment inaccuracy.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2163-2179 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `sed -i || true` runs without post-edit grep verification that `model_reasoning_effort = "${MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT}"` now exists, and the script echoes "Restored ..." unconditionally if `_discover_reasoning_patched=true`.
  WHY: If `sed` fails silently, the config stays at discover `"low"` and later validate phases run with degraded output quality; the reviewer gave this the highest severity among all reviewers.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2065-2096 and 2163-2179 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `sed -i` without `''` assumes GNU sed and fails on BSD/macOS.
  WHY: On macOS/local standalone runs the discover patch and restore can be skipped, and the reviewer notes this expands the failure surface; severity reflects the reviewer's highest rating.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:30-64 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT_DISCOVER` case rejects `"none"` and falls back to `low`.
  WHY: The reviewer described this as a behavior change for callers expecting the old default, though also noted CI is fine and the change is aligned with the catalog.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2163-2179 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The restore `sed` operation runs with `|| true` and then unconditionally logs "Restored..." when `_discover_reasoning_patched="true"`, but it never verifies that the expected line is present.
  WHY: If the restore silently fails, later phases run at the discover-level reasoning instead of `medium`, and the log falsely claims restoration succeeded.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
